Name: Portraits with more Personality
Author: professionalhacker1010
Description:
We all know the portraits in Stardew look kinda [b]wonky[/b]. So I created a mod that adds more [b]personality and appeal [/b]to the faces of your in-game romantic partners. Instead of monotonous oval faces, you now get[b] circles, squares, rectangles, triangles, and more[/b]. Sebastian has ear piercings. Emily looks like a Mean Girl. Sam's hair isn't a disaster. [b]Every character[/b] has some improvement to their look.

Have fun guys, I hope you like this mod as much as I liked making it :)

---

Some of the preview images have text from farmerjack's dialogue expansion mods.
